hebrewText: וַ/יִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּ/יהוּדָ֑ה כִּֽי שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/אֵין עִמּ֤/וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּ/שָּׁנִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כִּֽי הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לֽ/וֹ

tokens.kjv: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification
Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
tokens.explanation: Yehudah — Judá, quarto filho de Jacó, tribo e reino

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.kjv: appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
a year (as a revolution of time)
tokens.explanation: shanah — ano, período de um ano completo

tokens.kjv: an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)
tokens.kjv: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
